name: task-manager
description: Connect Task Manager to inspect and safely mutate work, including staged upload from native or exact local files.

interface.shortDescription: Manage tasks, comments, and staged files safely.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Task Manager with OAuth, resolve canonical references and current versions, mutate task metadata, labels, hierarchy and relations, and use native comments and private attachments. A bundled macOS companion can read one exact host-authorized local file into the same staged fileRef workflow without sending its path to Task Manager. Delivery workflows such as ShipTask are installed separately.
defaultPrompt: List tasks for a project or release and help me choose what to do next
Relate two tasks using their current canonical references
Upload an exact local file to TM-123 and add it to a native comment
